name: Smart-Core Holdings Limited
summary: Smart-Core Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, distributes integrated circuits and other electronic components in Hong Kong, the People's Republic of China, Singapore, Japan, and internationally. It operates through two segments, Authorised Distribution and Mixed Distribution. The company offers SoC (System on Chip) chips; memory chips and modules comprising DRAM, NOR Flash, NAND Flash, MCP, KGD wafers, and enterprise-grade eSSDs; and core transmitter- and receiver-end chips and components for data communication optical modules.
